references.text: Describes a similar event where Jesus meets demon-possessed men in the land of the Gadarenes, who are also healed by sending the demons into a herd of pigs.
Tells about Jesus' encounter with a demon-possessed man in the land of the Gerasenes, which has parallels to the event in Matthew involving exorcism and the herd of pigs.
Contains a similar account of Jesus healing a demon-possessed man, demonstrating Jesus' power over evil.
